openings.claim: Unequal topic familiarity may impede pair entry; preserve the valued structure.
openings.discriminator: Fresh shared starts improve reciprocal speech and usefulness, especially with familiarity differences.
openings.probe: Randomly offer consenting pairs usual or equivalent self-contained prompts plus one-minute introductions; privately record familiarity, anonymously observe reciprocal-start latency and individual speaking minutes, collect usefulness and preparation time.
openings.uncertainty: Proficiency and prompt differences remain alternatives; preparation cost is unproven.

openings.claim: Preparation mistakes may reflect stale task information.
openings.discriminator: Dated paper handoffs reduce earlier-task answers; distinguish blanks.
openings.probe: Compare identical tasks in existing versus dated-card formats; privately identify task/session, correct misunderstandings, then give everyone dated information. Log printing, explanation and messaging time.
openings.uncertainty: Immediate identification may not predict later recall.

openings.claim: Optional individual scaffolds and allocated turns may enable shared-prompt practice without public proficiency labels; continuous self-calibration remains speculative.
openings.discriminator: Supported rounds improve both partners’ useful minutes and narrow speaking-time gaps; balance without usefulness weakens explanation.
openings.probe: Counterbalance usual/supported rounds with comparable fresh prompts; offer sentence starters/extensions, alternate two six-minute speaker roles, then jointly reconsider support. Observe individual speaking time; collect usefulness/entry slips and preparation cost.
openings.uncertainty: Reliable challenge signals, independent scaffolds and affordable adaptation are unproven; balance alone is insufficient.

openings.claim: Six dated detachable cards and spare printed packets may preserve preparation continuity after absences without learner tracking.
openings.discriminator: Earlier-task errors decrease; persistent blanks suggest another barrier.
openings.probe: Counterbalance sheet/packet identification, then assess six sessions; separate earlier answers/blanks and count creation, printing/replacement effort.
openings.uncertainty: Requires stable topics, self-contained tasks, clear dates and packet retention/replacement.

decision: Historical synthetic proposals, not replication. Preserve free inclusive entry despite absence or declined public labels; one room/75 Wednesday minutes, no paid facilitator time, account/smartphone-free preparation, conversational purpose. Six-session targets: 80% report ≥10 useful minutes, 85% identify next task, coordination <90 minutes/week. Useful-practice definitions, attendance reasons and coordination breakdown remain unmeasured; speaking was untimed and slips unlinked. Test openings separately; preparation never gates entry.
